integrity: Analytical Markov proof plus finite independent matrix-generator checks; not an independent mathematical audit.
scientific_limitations: Stationary Poisson resetting to zero, constant diffusivity, symmetric stationary telegraph and Gaussian baths, deterministic integrable nonnegative filters; does not cover nonlinear or sign-changing responses. Priority remains subject to unindexed general multipoint results.
title: Four-time sign fingerprints of covariance-matched resetting, Gaussian, and telegraph baths
